domain: Square n by n integer matrix;1<=n<=1000, entries0..n.
local_effect_policy: read-only arguments; fresh mutable returns and no output-to-input aliases; explicit local policy, not official mutation requirement
objective: Lexicographically smallest lowercase string with exactly the given pairwise suffix LCP lengths, or empty string if impossible.
result_comparison: exact typed value; JS2569 canonical BigInt tags normalize to exact integers only
result_semantics: Lexicographically smallest lowercase string with exactly the given pairwise suffix LCP lengths, or empty string if impossible.

source_complexity_review.property: Assign smallest equality-class letters then verify every matrix recurrence; O(n^2) time and O(n) auxiliary space.
source_complexity_review.status: both exact owner sources statically reviewed, not executed
